name: How can I tell if my home has dry rot?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my home has dry rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Identifying dry rot often involves looking for specific signs such as a distinct musty smell, deep cracks in wooden surfaces, or a powdery orange-brown spore dust. You might also notice fungal growth resembling cotton wool or mushroom-like fruiting bodies. Since dry rot can hide behind walls, a professional inspection from a company like Maine Results, Inc. in areas such as Garden City or Meridian can help confirm its presence and assess the extent of the damage, guiding your next steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a musty smell, deep wood cracks, orange-brown spore dust, or cotton wool-like fungal growth to identify dry rot.
